segments.title: 第140章 舔狗精神
segments.content:
What does it feel like to hug a girl?

In Li Luo's thirty-plus years of life, it seemed he had never had such an experience.

When he was little, he would often roughhouse with Ying Chanxi.

Later, after getting familiar with Xu Youyu, he would often be met with her laughing scolds and playful kicks and punches after saying some flirtatious words.

As for Yan Zhusheng, she mostly didn't have the habit of getting physical, only occasionally touching his hand when correcting his posture and fingering for the guitar.

But a situation like this, where a girl threw herself directly into his arms, was something Li Luo had never experienced before.

Not even once.

"Are you, are you okay?" Li Luo felt his hands stiffen. After supporting Ying Chanxi's shoulders, he could clearly feel her scorching breath against the chest of his short-sleeved school uniform.

"I'm exhausted... I can barely breathe..." Ying Chanxi's hands clutched Li Luo's collar, her entire body leaning on him, as if she couldn't support herself.

At this moment, many people from Class One ran down from the stands, forming a circle around Li Luo and Ying Chanxi.

Liu Shaowen even handed over a sealed bottle of water, "Want to rehydrate?"

Perhaps because the whole class already knew Li Luo was Ying Chanxi's cousin, no one thought much of their intimate contact.

They just looked at Ying Chanxi with concern.

Xie Shuchen said excitedly, "Third place! You actually got third place, that's so awesome! The first place was a sports-focused student. To get into the top three despite that, Class President, you're amazing."

During her final sprint, Ying Chanxi had focused her entire being on the sprint itself, not paying any attention to how many people she had overtaken.

After hearing her ranking, she, who had been keeping her head down, finally looked up at her surroundings, then at Li Luo in front of her, her cheeks growing slightly hot.

Fortunately, her face was already flushed from the strenuous exercise, so no one noticed anything unusual.

Li Luo took the mineral water from Liu Shaowen, twisted it open, and brought it to Ying Chanxi's lips. "Take a few sips, then walk around a bit to cool down. If you stop right after running, you'll feel even worse later."

Ying Chanxi nodded obediently and, under Liu Shaowen's expectant gaze, drank a few sips of water. Then, with one hand on Li Luo's shoulder, she began to walk slowly on the sports field's grass.

Seeing that Ying Chanxi was fine, most of the Class One students dispersed and returned to their own stands.

Liu Shaowen and Xie Shuchen had wanted to follow, but with Li Luo there to accompany her, the two of them decided not to be an eyesore.

Only on the way back to the stands, Liu Shaowen excitedly punched Xie Shuchen a couple of times and laughed loudly, "See? See? This is the benefit of having a good relationship with Li Luo."

"No, what benefit are you talking about?" Xie Shuchen looked at him strangely. "What are you so excited about? It's not like Ying Chanxi threw herself into your arms."

"What do you know?" Liu Shaowen chuckled. "Didn't you see? Who gave her the water that Ying Chanxi just drank? Huh? Speak up."

Xie Shuchen looked speechless. "...You had the only bottle of water in the entire field. Whose would she drink if not yours?"

"But during the military training, I brought Ying Chanxi drinks, and she never drank them. Today, she did." Liu Shaowen said with a determined look in his eyes, "Isn't this the first step to victory? I have successfully taken the most difficult step!"

"Damn!" Xie Shuchen stared, dumbfounded, at the high-spirited Liu Shaowen. After a moment's thought, he suddenly felt it made a lot of sense. "You're a quick-witted one. But I get to train with Li Luo often. You just wait, my proximity will give me the advantage. Your head start is useless."

Li Luo, of course, didn't know about the two boys' excitement over there. He just supported Ying Chanxi as they walked for a while.

Only after she had recovered from that weak and powerless state did he slowly let go.

Ying Chanxi glanced at Li Luo's shoulder, a little reluctant to let go, but she was too embarrassed to keep pretending and simply smiled, "I got into the top three, you know. You'd better do well tomorrow."

"You're putting a lot of pressure on me," Li Luo clicked his tongue. "What if I don't get into the top three?"

"If you don't, you don't. I'm not like some people who only question others before the race," Ying Chanxi huffed. "Even if you come in last, I'll still cheer for you."

"So I have to thank you for that?"

"Of course."

The two bickered on the sports field. Once Ying Chanxi had more or less recovered, they each returned to their seats in the stands.

When Yan Zhusheng saw Li Luo return, she took out her harmonica and, based on her memory from just now, played a short segment of "Light"'s melody.

Then she stopped and asked, "How does it go after that?"

Li Luo paused for a moment, then after a bit of recollection, he hummed a section.

After he had hummed the entire song, Yan Zhusheng nodded in satisfaction, then asked curiously, "When did you write this song?"

"It was inspired by something a while ago."

"Don't tell me you've written other songs that you just haven't sung?"

"...You think too highly of me."

"Are you going to record this song too?" Yan Zhusheng asked. "You can come to my house this weekend."

"Let's record it together with 'Chaser of the Light'." Li Luo thought for a moment and said, "Is this weekend doable?"

"I'll give you an email address," Yan Zhusheng said. "When you get home tonight, send the sheet music to this address. Just say that I told you to send it."

"Whose email?"

"Auntie Luo Fei's," Yan Zhusheng said. "For a simple arrangement, a day or two is enough. We can use it directly on the weekend."

"Alright then." Li Luo nodded, then remembered Ying Chanxi's instructions and said, "In that case, on the weekend, should I ask Xixi and Xuejie to come along?"

Hearing this, Yan Zhusheng blinked her eyes, then nodded lightly, "Okay."

On the sports field, after the girls' 1500-meter races for all three grades had concluded, the time had already reached half-past five in the evening.

The announcer on the rostrum declared that the day's events had concluded smoothly and successfully, and thanked everyone for their hard work and effort throughout the day.

Then, everyone walked down from the stands in groups, swarming towards the cafeteria.

Vanguards of the cafeteria like Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang were already prepared. Showing no signs of having competed today, their figures were a blur as they dashed towards the cafeteria.

Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng followed leisurely behind, meeting up with Ying Chanxi and Qiao Xinyan from Class One's side, and also calling Zhao Rongjun over.

Initially, upon seeing several girls around Li Luo, Zhao Rongjun was hesitant and didn't want to come, but in the end, Li Luo had to drag him over by the neck.

"What event did you sign up for? I don't think I saw you at all," Li Luo asked.

"I just signed up for shot put," Zhao Rongjun said in a low voice. "It's tomorrow."

"Oh, I see." Li Luo nodded, then asked quietly, "So, how are things with your deskmate? Have you asked?"

"This... I don't know how to ask," Zhao Rongjun scratched his head, troubled. "You told me to ask if she has a boyfriend, but it's not really appropriate to ask something like that directly, is it?"

"Who told you to ask directly?" Li Luo looked exasperated. "Just say you have a friend who might be interested in her and asked you to find out if she's seeing anyone."

"Or when you're chatting, just say you have a friend who recently started dating someone secretly. Then see if she picks up on the topic. Once you get to talking, you can casually ask about her own situation, right?"

"Use that little brain of yours. Don't be so rigid when you talk."

After hearing this, Zhao Rongjun felt he had a point and nodded, "I'll try to find a chance then."

"What are you two whispering about?" Ying Chanxi asked curiously. "What are you plotting?"

"Nothing," Li Luo waved his hand. "This is men's business. Girls shouldn't get involved."

"Tch, as if anyone's interested."

"Oh, right," Li Luo remembered something and said to Ying Chanxi, "I just arranged with Yan Zhusheng to go to her house this weekend to record a song. Remember to come along."

"This weekend?" Ying Chanxi was surprised for a moment, then immediately nodded. "It's a deal then. I'm going too."

Hearing this, Qiao Xinyan, who was beside them, instantly grew curious. "What song recording? A song Li Luo sang?"

"He wrote two songs himself recently and wants to record them in a studio," Ying Chanxi explained. "It just so happens that Zhusheng has a dedicated recording studio at home, so we're borrowing it."

"Can I come and watch?" Qiao Xinyan asked expectantly. "I've never seen how a song is recorded."

"Is that okay, Zhusheng?" Ying Chanxi turned to look at Yan Zhusheng.

"Sure," Yan Zhusheng nodded, then looked at Zhao Rongjun next to Li Luo. "Do you want to come too?"

"Uh... that... I'll just..."

"Come on, you've got nothing to do this weekend anyway." Li Luo wrapped his arm around his good friend's neck. "With the sports meet these two days, we can finish our weekend homework during evening self-study. Then you'll be free as a bird and can come straight to Yan Zhusheng's house to record."

"We can buy some groceries in the afternoon, and I'll cook a great meal for you all."

"Let's just consider it a celebration for the successful conclusion of the sports meet."

Seeing that he had put it that way, Zhao Rongjun found it hard to refuse and could only nod helplessly.

He was also quite curious about how Li Luo wrote these new songs; it was just the presence of so many girls that made him a bit reluctant to go.

"Does Zhao Rongjun not like hanging out with girls?" Qiao Xinyan asked with a smile. "It was the same last time when we were studying together at Li Luo's house. He sat in a corner by himself and didn't say a word for ages."

"Uh... it's not that I don't like it..." Zhao Rongjun quickly waved his hands to explain, but he stammered for a long time without managing to get a few words out.

In the end, it was Li Luo who said with a smile, "He's just an honest guy. He doesn't know what to say when he sees pretty girls. It's all your fault for being too good-looking, it's not his problem."

"Haha, you can just say that about Xixi and Zhusheng. Why include me?" Qiao Xinyan said this, but she still looked quite happy.

Zhao Rongjun looked at Li Luo's ability to easily make girls laugh, feeling a little envious in his heart.

Unfortunately, he couldn't learn it at all.

It was a good thing he had a good friend like Li Luo, otherwise, he felt he would be fated to have no connection with women in his lifetime.

"He's just a smooth-talker. I don't know where he picked up that bad habit." Ying Chanxi looped her arm through Qiao Xinyan's and led her forward. "Xinyan, don't pay any attention to him."

(End of Chapter)
